domains.name: Design System Maintenance
domains.scope: Trace token dependencies and coordinate component contracts, renames and consumer retirement without assuming runtime or release readiness.

skills.name: component-deprecation-consumer-handoff
skills.description: Prepare a consumer-specific retirement handoff when a design-system component is being deprecated and its replacement may not preserve every supported behavior.

skills.name: component-variant-compatibility-matrix
skills.description: Build a supported-state matrix for component variants when independent properties can combine into invalid or undefined behavior.

skills.name: design-token-alias-cycle-diagnosis
skills.description: Trace design-token references to locate cycles, missing targets and affected consumers when a token cannot resolve.

skills.name: design-token-rename-migration-map
skills.description: Map a proposed design-token rename through aliases, generated outputs and consumer references when preserving a value alone may not preserve compatibility.
